Christmas Open House 2026
Calling all Crafters! If you make your crafts, bake or grow your own produce we welcome you to come
and sell your crafts at our Christmas Open House on November 21, 2026, from 9-2. Come and join us
at the South Hill Town Square at 105 W Danville Street. If you are baking, please remember that you
must follow the cottage laws under VDACS for labeling all your products.
The Christmas Market will take place, rain, snow or shine, on Saturday, November 21, 2026 from 9
a.m. to 2 p.m. Each 10 x 10 spot is $25.
